## New Jersey Division of Revenue — Notary Public law, including remote and electronic notarization

New Jersey Department of the Treasury, Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services · NJ · **read and cite only — copyrighted, do not reproduce**

<https://www.nj.gov/treasury/revenue/notary-public-law.shtml>

Machine-readable: <https://pub.njleg.gov/bills/2020/PL21/179_.HTM>

**Authoritative for:** The State's implementation of P.L. 2021, c. 179 — which notarial acts may be performed remotely, on what platforms, and the exclusion of records governed by the law of wills and codicils (N.J.S.A. 52:7-10.10).

## New Jersey Statutes — current text

<https://lis.njleg.state.nj.us/nxt/gateway.dll?f=templates&fn=default.htm>
